name: chat_terse
use_case: Short single-turn question answered in a sentence or two.
rationale: Observed production shape for short-answer assistants: ~80 tokens in, 25-30 out. The short output is the point. Fixed per-request cost amortises over 30 tokens rather than hundreds, so requests/sec is the figure to quote and tokens/sec understates what the server is doing. KV per request is ~110 tokens, far below any plausible pool, so concurrency is bounded by --max-num-seqs and compute, never by KV.
duplicate_note: These indices repeat an earlier prompt verbatim, on purpose. With prefix caching OFF they are indistinguishable from any other prompt. With it ON they are the only prompts able to hit the cache, which is how to measure the caching effect without contaminating the uncached figure.
